features.name: x1_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of x1 using training mean and std, clipped to [-3, 3] for robustness
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth normalized continuous feature suitable for linear SVM margins

features.name: x2_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of x2 using training mean and std, clipped to [-3, 3]
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth normalized continuous feature suitable for linear SVM margins

features.name: x4_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of x4 using training mean and std, clipped to [-3, 3]
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth normalized continuous feature suitable for linear SVM margins

features.name: x6_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalization of x6 using training mean and std, clipped to [-3, 3]
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth normalized continuous feature for wide-range variable x6

features.name: x9_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalization of x9 to [0, 1] range using training min/max
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized continuous feature for x9 useful for linear SVM decision boundaries

features.name: x10_deviation
features.description: Deviation of x10 from its midpoint (1100), normalized by half-range
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative position of x10 within its range, useful for linear separation

features.name: x1_x4_interaction
features.description: Normalized product of x1 and x4 as a linear interaction term
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures linear interaction between x1 and x4 for SVM margin improvement

features.name: x2_x6_ratio
features.description: Ratio of x2 to x6 after shifting both to positive domain, log-transformed for stability
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative magnitude relationship between x2 and x6 for linear separation

features.name: x3_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of categorical x3: brown=0, red=1, green=2, ordered by frequency
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts categorical x3 to numeric for linear SVM compatibility

features.name: x7_binary
features.description: Binary encoding of x7: no=0, yes=1
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts binary categorical x7 to numeric for linear SVM

features.name: x8_binary
features.description: Binary encoding of x8: normal=0, large=1
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts binary categorical x8 to numeric for linear SVM

features.name: composite_severity_score
features.description: Semantic composite score combining normalized magnitudes of x1, x4, x5, and x9 deviation from midpoint, weighted to reflect overall feature intensity. Higher values indicate more extreme combined feature values across multiple dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single weighted composite severity measure that approximates a linear projection useful for SVM margin separation
